ICHIGO-HOLLOW_MASK.title: Hollow Mask
ICHIGO-HOLLOW_MASK.description: Gain [gold]5[/gold] Reiryoku at the start of your turn, [gold]3[/gold] when you play an Attack and [gold]6[/gold] when you play a [gold]Getsuga Tenshou[/gold]. At [gold]100[/gold] Reiryoku, enter [gold]Bankai[/gold].
ICHIGO-HOLLOW_MASK.flavor: A fragment of something that was never supposed to be part of him.
ICHIGO-ZANGETSU.description: Gain 5 [blue]Reiryoku[/blue] at the start of every turn. Heal 5 HP at the end of combat.
ICHIGO-ZANGETSU.title: Zangetsu
ICHIGO-HOUGYOKU.flavor: A small sphere with the unsettling habit of granting desires.
ICHIGO-HOUGYOKU.title: Hougyoku
ICHIGO-TENSA_ZANGETSU.description: Gain 2 additional [blue]Reiryoku[/blue] at the start of every turn and from attacks. Heal 7 HP at the end of combat.
ICHIGO-TENSA_ZANGETSU.title: Tensa Zangetsu
ICHIGO-COMBAT_PASS.title: Combat Pass
ICHIGO-COMBAT_PASS.description: At the start of combat, apply 1 [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold] to ALL enemies.
ICHIGO-COMBAT_PASS.flavor: Valid for unlimited trips between the World of the Living and Soul Society. Probably.
ICHIGO-SENNAS_RIBBON.title: Senna's Ribbon
ICHIGO-SENNAS_RIBBON.description: At the start of combat, gain 25 [gold]Reiryoku[/gold].
ICHIGO-SENNAS_RIBBON.flavor: A red ribbon carried by the wind, tied to a memory that refuses to disappear.
ICHIGO-PONKICHI_PLUSHIE.title: Ponkichi Plushie
ICHIGO-PONKICHI_PLUSHIE.description: Enemies with [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold] deal 25% less damage.
ICHIGO-PONKICHI_PLUSHIE.flavor: My name is NOT Ponkichi! It's Kon!
ICHIGO-SPIRIT_CORE.title: Spirit Core
ICHIGO-SPIRIT_CORE.flavor: Spiritual pressure condensed until even the air around it feels heavy.
ICHIGO-GOKON_TEKKOU.title: Gokon Tekkou
ICHIGO-GOKON_TEKKOU.description: [gold]Spiritual Fracture[/gold] applied through [gold]Soul Disruption[/gold] lasts 1 additional turn.
ICHIGO-GOKON_TEKKOU.flavor: For when asking a soul to leave politely isn't working.
